PC Errata 2017 disc card of [[Wes Janson]]: A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 11 April 2017. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy. Source: Players Committee card image [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/wesjanson.gif wesjanson.gif] in the starwarsccg.org card lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170411105821/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/wesjanson.gif Internet Archive] (11 April 2017, the earliest archived copy); the same file was still served on 21 August 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260821170554/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/wesjanson.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Wes Janson (PC Errata 2017 disc card)]].
